modules.name: SynTHBloK-QUAD
modules.description: Quad-oscillator synth voice with filter, envelope, glide, accent and LFO

modules.name: SynTHBloK Stereo Expander
modules.description: Stereo width, tilt, air, glue, punch and clip, with analyzer

modules.name: SynTHBloK FX Expander
modules.description: Delay and space effects with tape, analog and modern character

modules.name: SynTHBloK-R Resonator
modules.description: Stereo modal resonator with metal, wood, membrane and tube bodies

modules.name: SynTHBloK MIX-24 Fire Edition
modules.description: Six-channel stereo mixer with per-channel tilt, drive, air and glue, mute/solo and meters

modules.name: SynTHBloK-F Flagship Filter
modules.description: Stereo state-variable filter with morph, drive, FM, keytrack and chaos

modules.name: BloKMaster
modules.description: Mastering strip: trim, tilt EQ, shelves, glue compressor, punch, limiter, stereo tools, air and output gain

modules.name: SynTHBloK Player Plus
modules.description: MIDI file player with a watch folder: 16 poly tracks (pitch, gate, velocity), 16th-note clock, reset and end outputs, speed and transpose

modules.name: SynTHBloK-K Kick
modules.description: Hard techno kick: pitch-swept sine, click, drive, tone, schranz rumble tail with ducking, accent and envelope out

modules.name: SynTHBloK MIDI + Expansion Module
modules.description: MIDI display for Player Plus: scrolling piano roll of the loaded MIDI with playhead, track activity and transport readout

modules.name: SynTHBloK-D Snare/Hat
modules.description: Techno snare and hi-hat voice: two-oscillator snare body with noise snap, six-oscillator metallic hats with closed/open triggers and choke, drive, tone and accent

modules.name: SynTHBloK-E Euclid
modules.description: Four-channel Euclidean rhythm generator: steps, hits and rotate per channel, clock/reset/run inputs, 10 ms trigger outputs for drums and gates

modules.name: SynTHBloK-J JAM Probe
modules.description: MIDI monitor and test transmitter for mapping controllers such as the Maschine JAM: live message log, per-control statistics, test notes/CCs, auto sweep, copy/save map summary

modules.name: SynTHBloK-K JAM
modules.description: Maschine JAM controller: 8x8 pad trigger sequencer with 8 patterns, plus the 8 touch strips as CV outputs with 8 banks; JAM lights follow the module

modules.name: SynTHBloK Matrix-8
modules.description: Maschine JAM groovebox: 8x8 step sequencer driving 8 built-in synth voices (morphing oscillator, resonant filter, envelopes, drive, pan), touch strips shape each voice, stereo out

modules.name: SynTHBloK GRAIN-FORGE
modules.description: Beat shuffler, glitch, robot vocoder, clock-locked gate/filter and a warp delay whose repeats loop back through the robot and pulse stages; clock-locked stereo FX chain

modules.name: SynTHBloK MATRIX-DUO
modules.description: LEAD and BASS dual-oscillator mono synths (wave morph, hard sync, FM, sub, 24 dB filter, ADSR, drive, glide) with their own 8-step note sequencer in a key and scale, 8 patterns, clock/reset/run in, audio, pitch and gate out
